newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER FALL.

text.p: Turnover fell to 7,365 denars at Thursday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 250,000 denars at the previous session on July 3 as two companies traded, the exchange said.
Usie sold five stocks at 700 denars, down 300 from the previous close and well below par of 3,100 denars.
Gerias Tsupev Strumitsa made its debut on the third floor, selling five stocks at 773 denars, below par of 1,023 denars.
Traded volume was 250 shares last Thursday.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
Macedonia on Wednesday devalued the denar to 31 to the German mark from 27.1 as part of a package of measures agreed with the IMF which include a freeze on state sector wages.
